name: center_marks_on_the_holes
why: ENTRY W2.11. Blocked since 17/9/2026 for «the API says yes and puts nothing». On 26/9 the probe found that the marks WERE THERE: SOLIDWORKS puts them by itself on the holes when it creates the view (document option «centre marks on holes», switched on here), and IView.GetCenterMarkCount() answers 0 because it does not count those. Enumerating them (GetFirstCenterMark/GetNext) there are three. From code a new mark is not born (measured: with the automatic ones removed, AddCenterMark does not put any back): the operation is a CHECK, which says which holes have the mark and refuses if one is missing.
defect_caught: Four: the counter that says zero on a sheet with three marks (the state, which recounts them on its own); the DOUBLE marks on the holes that already have them; a second call that doubles; and the fillets, on which the mark from code is not born (measured: 4 arcs out of 4), which must be a refusal and not a «done» with zero marks.
_and_the_hole_without_a_mark: The refusal for a hole without a mark was proved by the little test rig (prova0089 croci7), removing the automatic marks: the bench has no operation that removes them, and on this installation every hole has its mark.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V2, the view from above: the holes are circles.

expect.why: a view attaches to the FILE of the part

three holes, three centre marks on the sheet after the operation, whoever made them. The marks SOLIDWORKS puts on holes when it creates the views were counted 3 in three full runs and alone, and 0 in the full run on 0.142.0 and in the drawing family run, with the same code, and not reproduced with the three cases that precede this one: an effect of long runs, still open. So the case no longer asks who made them (already there: 3 recognised and 0 added; missing: 3 added), only that the sheet ends with three and not six
